# Bundled PDF dependency

`pdf-lib.min.js` is the unmodified browser UMD build of **pdf-lib 1.17.1**, published by Andrew Dillon and contributors: <https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib/tree/v1.17.1>.

It is distributed under the MIT license; see `pdf-lib.LICENSE.txt`. The installed package’s `dist/pdf-lib.min.js` was copied verbatim. No source map or network CDN is needed. The runtime lazy-loads this asset only for PDF tools. Keep its license alongside every deployed copy.
